capabilities: Sync issues and pull requests from multiple GitHub and GitLab repositories on startup or on an interval
Create markdown notes for each issue or PR with filename and content templates and YAML frontmatter
Display GitHub Projects v2 as kanban boards with custom field support
Track sub-issues with parent/child navigation and completion percentage
Filter issues by labels, assignees, and reviewers, and clean up old closed items
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not GitHub-only: it also supports GitLab issues and merge requests, pull requests, and GitHub Projects boards.
extras: Detailed setup and usage documentation is hosted externally; the README covers installation and configuration steps only.
intentEvidence: I had already started working on my prototype before I discovered the plugin, and had initially even given it a similar name.
motivation: The author had already built a prototype before discovering a similar existing plugin and continued with their own version.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow issues, pull requests, or project boards from GitHub or GitLab inside the vault.

relations.evidence: integrates with GitHub and GitLab to track issues and pull requests directly in your vault
Full support for GitLab Issues and Merge Requests

summary: Issue tracker that syncs GitHub and GitLab issues, pull requests, and projects into Obsidian notes and views.
